description: Compare two caller-named teams using caller-supplied strength ratings (1-100). Returns hypothetical strength-share percentages and one seeded simulated winner. No live sports data, injuries, bookmaker odds, draws or validated forecasts. Entertainment and what-if math only. Price: 0.005 USDC. Mode: computed_service. Source: User-supplied ratings and a hypothetical strength-share model. Set auto_pay=true for a one-call purchase when the local buyer wallet is configured.

auto_pay.description: Automatically authorize and pay this request with the locally configured buyer wallet. Requires X402_AUTO_PAY=true and X402_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

payment_id.description: payment_id returned by the x402 invoice.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE produced by a compatible buyer client.

preview.description: Inspect a rate-limited live contract proof showing source, freshness, response shape, and required inputs. Decision-ready values remain in the paid result.

rating_a.description: Your hypothetical rating of the first team, not a live statistic.

rating_b.description: Your hypothetical rating of the second team.

tx_hash.description: Base transaction hash after paying an x402 invoice.

name: sports_matchup_simulator
